context: Seven fullGreg110 input sets/53 outcomes and1000 simulations per candidate/input. That negative alternative does not validate the current target-line effect when omission fits. Broadening is closer in the six-hero mixed case and still plausible. Immediate/two-turn and delayed/one-turn alternatives also remain compatible; exact chance,delay,lifetime,scope and magnitude remain unresolved.
